title: Fight effects · the GPU particle engine
description: Each preset of effects.fightFx (src/effects.ts) on the GPU engine (src/fight-particles.ts): crisp lines, shards that become frost, chains drawn as strands, tinted vortices, a swarm that sees itself, sticky gum that splats, rising cures and fireworks with trails that burst; then crystals particles stay inside, orbit or gather on, meteors and fireflies, whose light falls on the dogs and the floor. Played on a dog in a real fight, captured at twice the pixels (--gpu --scale 2) on the game's clock at 30 fps.

steps.eval: window.lab = (() => { const g = window.gerard.game; document.querySelector('#battle').style.visibility = 'hidden'; const ids = g.fighterIds(), foe = ids.filter(f => !f.party)[1].id, ally = ids.find(f => f.party).id; return { play(name, o = {}) { g.effects.clear(); return g.fx(name, foe, { from: ally, ...o }); } }; })();

steps.caption: Needles: a blow's chips as crisp little lines of every size, spinning, skittering off the dogs and the floor
Shatter (ice): spinning shards glance off the dogs and turn to frost where they land, a ring of frost at the feet
Arc (energy): chains of light leap from above and crackle off the dog's surface, each chain one line, swirled round it
Vortex (an ánima's colour, tinted): a ring of motes and trailing strands spiral up round the dog; motes twinkle out as they die
Swarm (shadow): particles that see each other, keeping apart, closing ranks and flying as one round the dog
Goo (gum): blobs that stick to the dogs and ride along, and splat where they land
Heal: green light rising from a ring round the feet, gathering as it rises (cohesion) and twinkling out
Fireworks: rockets each with a chain trailing behind, bursting into embers when they die
Prison: a crystal closes round the dog; light caught inside bounces off its glass walls and off the dog, and lights the dog from within
Orbit: motes and strands drawn onto a shell round a crystal over the dog's head, circling its faces; their light falls on the dogs
Gather: a crystal pulls embers in from all round, they settle on its faces and slide, until it bursts into shards with a flash
Meteor: trails fall from high up and flare on landing; the light comes down with them and lights the floor and the dogs
Fireflies: warm lights wander round the dog, keeping apart, and light it as they pass

steps.eval: { const gpu = window.gerard.game.effects.gpu; window.softKinds = ['mote', 'twinkle', 'heal']; window.savedKinds = Object.fromEntries(softKinds.map(k => [k, gpu.get(k)])); softKinds.forEach(k => gpu.define(k, { ...savedKinds[k], blur: 0 })); }

steps.caption: Vortex with every particle crisp (blur 0): hard dots and stars

steps.eval: { const gpu = window.gerard.game.effects.gpu; softKinds.forEach(k => gpu.define(k, savedKinds[k])); }

steps.caption: The same vortex as defined: motes blur as they fade (blur 0 → 0.9) and twinkle out softly, like light out of focus
